title: glab api projects/${project}/milestones?per_page=${n} [--paginate]
description: The project's milestones, open and closed, ${project} its path URL-encoded: every one, per_page=100 with --paginate, which prints one such array per page, which kit draws as the milestones stage's in `modules/bash/forge/gitlab.sh` (forge/gitlab:milestones, with `modules/jq/forge.jq` forge::gitlab_milestones), and the newest by update, with order_by=updated_at&sort=desc&per_page=1, whose iid and updated_at make a mark (forge/gitlab:marks, with forge::gitlab_marks). The types are APIEntitiesMilestone of GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/milestones in GitLab's REST OpenAPI, https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/raw/master/doc/api/openapi/openapi_v3.yaml, as https://docs.gitlab.com/api/milestones/ describes them.

id.description: The milestone's own, which its issues are listed by.
